title: 金流端到端整合驗收 (AWS 全線串接)
content: After all Phase 1 infrastructure (RDS, S3, SES) and all 金流與收據 cards are deployed, run full end-to-end verification covering the complete payment-to-receipt flow with real AWS services.

commands: npx prisma db push (database already in sync)
findings: AWS infrastructure foundation deployed: amplify.yml, src/lib/aws.ts (S3+SES clients), GET /api/health endpoint
RDS PostgreSQL accessible from Amplify Lambda (0.0.0.0/0 rule applied)
AUTH_SECRET and DATABASE_URL configured in Amplify Console env vars
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and AUTH_URL set to Amplify domain
trustHost: true added to NextAuth config for Amplify host header compatibility
SSR fetch fixed: courses pages use NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL instead of unreliable host header
evidence.residual: EN-004 (presigned URL routes) and PR-003 (PDF receipt + SES) not yet implemented. S3 buckets need to be created in AWS console. SES sender email needs verification. This verification card stays backlog until those cards are done.

acceptance: 1. S3 upload: upload payment proof via /en/courses/{slug}/enroll → file stored in S3, paymentProofUrl saved in DB
2. Admin review list: visit /en/admin/enrolments → table loads all enrolments with real user/course data from RDS
3. Payment proof preview: click an enrolment row → modal loads image via S3 presigned GET URL
4. Approve flow: click Approve → paymentStatus=VERIFIED, receiptNumber=RCPT-{YYYY}-{NNNNN} generated, PDF stored in S3
5. Email delivery: after approval, SES delivers email with PDF attachment to registrant's email
6. PDF password: downloaded receipt opens with registrant's idDocNumber as password
7. Reject flow: click Reject with reason → paymentStatus=REJECTED, reason stored, no PDF/email generated
8. Receipt re-download: registrant visits dashboard → can re-download receipt PDF from S3 presigned URL
9. Non-admin 403: logout → visit /en/admin/enrolments → redirected to login
10. All flows pass in zh-hk and zh-cn locales
files: No new files — verification only against deployed infra
verification: Run all 10 acceptance criteria against staging environment with real RDS, S3, SES. Collect screenshots for each step. Log any failures as follow-up cards. Do not mark PR-004 done until all 10 pass.
